title: Il gatto mammone
writer: Sandro Continenza, Francesco Longo, Raimondo Vianello
actors: Lando Buzzanca, Rossana Podestà, Gloria Guida
plot: Sicilian Lollo Mascalucia, a small pasta factory owner has been married to Rosalia for seven years, pretending to all his fellow villagers that he doesn't want a child.
